pick.headline: EgyptAir flight 648 hijacked to Malta
pick.summary: On November 23, 1985, Abu Nidal gunmen hijacked an EgyptAir flight from Athens and forced it down in Malta. Egyptian commandos stormed the plane the next day and some sixty people died.
pick.significance: One of the deadliest hijackings of the decade, it came weeks after the Achille Lauro affair and fed US pressure to act against states sponsoring terrorism.
pick.fbis: FBIS's regional review of November 26, 1985, cited TANJUG on a joint communique in which Abu Nidal's faction and an 'Organization of Egypt's Revolutionaries' claimed the hijacking.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: South Asia, Vol. VIII No. 228, 26 November 1985
evidence.snippet: …In a joint communique released 26 November in Beirut, the dissident Palestinian faction led by Abu Nidal (Sabri al-Banna) and the “Organization of Egypt's Revolutionaries” claimed responsibility for the hijacking of an Egyptair airliner and warned that “in the coming surpise oper- ations, young heroes from many Arab countries will be engaged, but Egyptians and Palestinians will be in the front lines of martyrs and heroes,” TANJUG reported.
